observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR body with a lens attached; Nikon logo visible on the front.
Photo 1 shows the camera from the front with a zoom lens attached; lens has markings consistent with a 70-300mm style zoom.
Photo 2 shows the camera side/rear angle; lens and body appear used with visible wear/scuffs on the body/lens barrel.
No photo clearly shows the model number/label for the camera body (e.g., D3400) or the exact lens model text beyond partial markings.

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera
claims.evidence: Photos show a Nikon DSLR body (Nikon logo), but the D3400 model text/label is not clearly readable in the provided images.
The lens shows partial markings consistent with a 70-300mm zoom, but the exact 70-300mm model text is not fully readable in the photos.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No photo/video of the camera powering on, autofocus test, shutter count/health, or any functional checks.

risks.risk: Camera body model may not be D3400 (could be another Nikon DSLR), which changes value and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model name/number from the body label (usually on the bottom plate) and/or the 'About' screen after powering on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Nikon DSLR kit with unknown exact model (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Lens may not be the exact 70-300mm or may be a different variant; also could have internal haze/fungus or worn optics.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens name/model text on the barrel + a photo/video of a bright light test (e.g., point a flashlight through the lens) and a sharpness test shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used zoom lens of uncertain exact model and assume optics may be imperfect.

risks.risk: Functional issues (shutter fault, autofocus failure, sensor dust, battery/charger problems) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video showing power-on, menu navigation, autofocus on a target, and a sample photo taken at 70mm and 300mm.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst-case).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, straps) can reduce usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (battery, charger, lens caps, strap, USB cable, memory card).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera bottom label showing the exact model (D3400) and serial number.
Clear photo of the lens barrel showing the exact lens model (confirm 70-300mm variant).
Video: power on + autofocus test + take 2 sample photos (one wide end, one at 300mm) showing sharpness.
Photo of included items (battery, charger, both lens caps, strap, memory card if any).
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Nikon DSLR with a zoom lens, but the exact D3400 model and exact 70-300mm lens variant are not clearly readable, and the 'working perfectly' claim isn’t verifiable without power-on/function tests.
